rows.notes: Do not expand legacy sand/cursor visual naming for new migrated UI. Any added capability must project through --fabushi-* semantic tokens and canonical components.
rows.responsibility: Embedded theme/accent system: system accent integration, bounded accent serialization, colorization exceptions, day/night palettes and default background preparation.
rows.state_machine: Theme application is transactional: parse/prepare/test -> explicit keep or revert; async resource/apply generations must fence stale results and theme changes must preserve route/draft/scroll.
rows.side_effects: Theme preference/palette/background resources, settings and conversation appearance; optional cloud resource fetch/upload.
rows.failure_cases: Oversized/malformed theme/background, unreadable contrast, stale async preview/download, failed file/cache restore, partial apply without revert, cross-conversation leakage and non-semantic feature styling.
rows.fabushi_target: Extend existing Theme/Settings/Conversation/Resource owners only where product requirements require custom/per-chat themes; preserve one semantic token graph and canonical UI component ownership.
rows.production_evidence: Existing SandThemeController provides persisted light/dark/system and native-theme synchronization; custom/cloud/editor responsibilities are not falsely marked implemented.
rows.test_evidence: Current theme-controller/design-system evidence is partial; parser/resource/apply-revert/per-conversation/visual acceptance required before verification.
